description: A multi-tool web intelligence toolkit for crawling, structured extraction, browser automation, screenshot comparison, site QA and source-grounded research.

capabilities: Crawl sites and extract structured page data
Operate browser sessions and inspect JavaScript-heavy pages
Compare source and clone screenshots across viewports
Audit links, metadata, console errors and navigation
Produce reproducible reports with evidence and coverage limits
defaultPrompt: Crawl this site with a page limit and extract its URLs, headings, metadata and links.
Compare the original website against my clone and report verified visual and functional differences.
Run an evidence-based website audit and produce a prioritized defect report.
interface.longDescription: Combine self-hosted crawling, browser automation and deterministic visual/functional testing. Guides workflows using Crawl4AI, agent-browser, Playwright and Crawlee, while adapting to the host tools actually available. Includes bounded extraction, source-grounded research, screenshot comparison, link checks and evidence-based website QA. Does not bundle a crawler server or claim external integrations are connected.

name: web-recon-toolkit
